correctness.rationale: The new proof uses ambient integral Schubert presentation, integral weak Lefschetz in low degrees, and the published cellular additive ranks. The n-by-n middle intersection Gram matrix has diagonal 2 except terminal 1 and adjacent 1, with determinant 1. In all upper degrees a dual Schubert pairing is integral lower triangular with diagonal 1. These imply restriction surjectivity over the integers. Projection formula plus Poincare duality identifies the precise kernel Ann(a^2). A standalone exact polynomial checker verifies all matrices and determinants for n=2,...,12; finite checking does not replace the symbolic Pieri proof.

value.rationale: The primary article explicitly raises the multiplicative cohomology question. The finding answers it for the infinite geometric two-plane family, with an effectively computable integral ring, full unimodular Schubert bases and a numerical obstruction distinguishing it from the same-Betti-number ordinary Grassmannian. This is more than a textbook low-degree consequence.
